messages:
maria_p: Quick preflight for tonight's RN + staff announce (deploy window 02:00-04:00 UTC). Need: 1) final internal blurb, 2) canary owner + pin owner. Also confirm rollback criteria and artifact naming.

sachin: Draft blurb: 'Deploying v1.29.0: runtime perf + cost updates. Includes KV-cache hotfix, updated quant profiles for Llama variants, and a rate-limit safety patch. Canary EU -> global. Rollback if error rate increases >1.5% or P95 latency regresses >200ms.'

lisa: Add a one-line customer impact: 'Estimated ~30% per-token cost reduction for streaming RLHF workloads.'

maria_p: New draft: 'v1.29.0 — runtime perf & cost: KV-cache hotfix, updated quant profiles (Llama family), and rate-limit safety patch. Expected ~30% per-token cost reduction for streaming RLHF workloads. Canary EU; global promo ~45–90m after canary. Rollback if error rate >1.5% or P95 latency +200ms.'

jordan: I'll own canary + rollback. My plan: deploybot --canary region=eu version=v1.29.0; observe 30m. If error_rate >1.5% OR P95 >200ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows -> rollback to v1.28.4 and invalidate KV caches on canary.

ops-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. Ping @ops-oncall at start. I'll have rollback scripts and traffic-split ready.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: run_id=DB-20240621-19, user=jordan, target=canary.eu, version=v1.29.0. Reply "confirm" to execute. Logs: https://internal.builds/DB-20240621-19

jordan: confirm

deploy-bot: deploy started: run_id=DB-20240621-19. Steps: provision canary pool -> apply bundle -> warm caches. ETA ~6m.

maria_p: Announcement draft to paste into #staff-announce after canary OK. Short header + 2 bullets.

maria_p (draft):
> Heads up — rolling out v1.29.0 tonight (02:00–04:00 UTC). Runtime perf & cost improvements (KV-cache fix + updated quant profiles). Expected ~30% per-token cost reduction for streaming RLHF workloads. Canary in EU; global promotion ~45–90m after canary if healthy. See RN: https://internal.docs/release/v1.29.0. Ops monitoring; rollback criteria: >1.5% error-rate increase or P95 latency regression >200ms.

sachin: tiny nit: 'per-token' looks good. Add 'SRE snippet' callout for the RN (evict cache steps + metric names).

maria_p: Added. Also request: CI artifact should be tagged v1.29.0+{short_sha} so rollbacks are exact. Can CI confirm?

deploy-bot: artifact tagging enabled. Will publish as v1.29.0+{short_sha}.

sachin: Adding deploy checklist to RN: 1) pre-deploy smoke 2) canary EU 3) 30m observe 4) promote or rollback 5) pin announce + metrics snapshot.

lisa: Who pins the staff announce once global promo finishes?

jordan: I'll post the final staff announce and pin after promote. Will include snapshot link.

ops-oncall: SRE snippet request: include hotfix eviction command, path to quant profiles, and temporary alert to watch: model_serving:error_rate and model_serving:latency_p95.

maria_p: Good. I'll add that to the RN. Thanks.

deploy-bot: canary step: provision -> success. apply -> success. warming -> started. Monitoring hooks enabled.

jordan: 30m snapshot: error_rate +0.13% (0.38% -> 0.51%), P95 +42ms. No customer-facing alerts. Promoting to global in 5.

deploy-bot: promotion started: run_id=DB-20240621-19 -> global.

jordan: promoted and posted metrics: https://internal.metrics/snapshots/DB-20240621-19. Pin done.

maria_p: Posting staff announce now and attaching RN link. Will follow up with quant-profile numbers in a short ticket.

ops-oncall: Marking window incident-free unless someone files.

sachin: Great job everyone :party_parrot:
